image:image.image:title: Generative Models - GAN, VAE, Diffusion Mathematical Structures
image:image.image:caption: Deep generative architectures visualized as parametric surfaces and latent space manifolds

image:image.image:title: GAN Generator Manifold - Latent Space Mapping
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: G(z) : R^d -> R^n, z ~ N(0,I). Generator network mapping latent vectors to data space.

image:image.image:title: GAN Discriminator Boundary - Real/Fake Classification Surface
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: D(x) = sigma(f(x)), min_G max_D E[log D(x)] + E[log(1-D(G(z)))]. Adversarial decision boundary.

image:image.image:title: WGAN Loss Landscape - Wasserstein Distance Surface
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: W(P_r, P_g) = inf E[||x-y||], Lipschitz constraint: ||f||_L <= 1. Earth Mover's distance optimization.

image:image.image:title: VAE Latent Manifold - Variational Autoencoder Space
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: ELBO = E_q[log p(x|z)] - KL(q(z|x) || p(z)). Variational lower bound with reparameterization.

image:image.image:title: VAE Reconstruction Surface - Decoder Output
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: x_hat = dec(z), z = mu + sigma * epsilon, epsilon ~ N(0,1). Reparameterized sampling.

image:image.image:title: Diffusion Forward Process - Noise Addition Schedule
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: q(x_t|x_{t-1}) = N(x_t; sqrt(1-beta_t)*x_{t-1}, beta_t*I). Markov chain noise injection.

image:image.image:title: Diffusion Reverse Process - Score-Based Denoising
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: p_theta(x_{t-1}|x_t) = N(x_{t-1}; mu_theta(x_t,t), Sigma_theta(x_t,t)). Learned denoising distribution.

image:image.image:title: Score Function Field - Gradient of Log Probability
image:image.image:caption: Mathematical: s_theta(x,t) = nabla_x log p_t(x). Score matching objective for generative modeling.
